0022600113.text: The Pacers are 1-1 after two games and come in on a one-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Central and 9th in the East, with a 1-0 road record and a 0-1 home record. Brooklyn is 0-1 and 10th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Atlantic, and Tyler Bilodeau is out with a shoulder injury, while for Indiana Ben Sheppard is out with a knee injury, Johnny Furphy is out after knee surgery, and T.J. McConnell is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision. Indiana won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 123-94 win in Brooklyn on April 9, and the teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
